scope: Offline evidence; no automatic production promotion or retraining.
referenceMeaning: Acoustic consensus is a diagnostic estimate, not manually annotated ground truth; label conflicts retained.
timingMeaning: Successful-case times are conditional; always read eligible/reached/notReached counts.

holdout.partition: new-source-group-validation; no tuning or retraining; not a future final test after inspecting results

protocol.referenceWindow: 8192 samples centered on original chunk end, before artificial cut; offline reference only
protocol.onsetProxy: start of first two consecutive original 5ms chunks with RMS > -60dBFS; not annotated physical onset
protocol.stableCorrect: notification time of fourth consecutive correct 5ms frame; all four require consensus where used; before cut only
limitations: Independent acoustic estimates are not human-verified F0.
Null acoustic reference excluded identically for both models; coverage retained.
Future context is used only to estimate the reference, not for either inference.
No real microphone, continuous singing, polyphony, or retraining.
Short notes and zero tail are artificial cuts, not actual staccato or measured silence.
